text_to_image_prompt: Create one standalone photorealistic female character portrait, 1086 x 1448 pixels, vertical 3:4. Strict frontal eye-level ID-photo composition with the entire head and upper torso visible, centered head and direct gaze, level shoulders, no head tilt or rotation. Balanced left and right cheek widths, cheekbone heights and jaw taper; level eyes and aligned nose, philtrum, lips and chin. Relaxed neutral expression. Solid pure white background, bright soft balanced frontal studio illumination, natural skin pores and fine hair detail, restrained makeup, gentle contrast and coherent warm neutral photographic grading. No scene, text, watermark, border, collage, extra person or visible hands. Long loose medium-brown waves with subtle golden highlights, fair neutral skin, gray-green eyes, full brown brows, softly parted rose lips. Navy blouse with a small tied neckline.
original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Make ONE new camera view of the exact same fictional female character in the attached confirmed portrait. Input image is the sole identity, skin-color, hair, outfit and accessory authority. Preserve her distinctive facial anatomy, eye color, skin tone, apparent age, hair color and hairstyle, clothing and visible accessories; do not redesign her face or beautify into another person. CHANGE ONLY camera angle, pose, expression and framing into a consistent ID-photo composition. Both shoulders square to camera, face perfectly frontal, head upright without tilt, nose vertically centered, camera exactly at eye height, both eyes open looking directly into lens, naturally closed relaxed lips, neutral composed expression. For a winking source, open both eyes naturally. Pure solid white #FFFFFF seamless background throughout. Bright neutral soft frontal studio daylight and subtle symmetrical natural shadows, realistic live-action photographic detail, natural pores, no plastic smoothing or heavy makeup. Vertical 3:4 canvas, output exactly 1086 pixels wide by 1448 pixels high. Consistent chest-up framing: complete hairstyle and any hat/headphones visible with at least 8 percent clear white margin above their highest point, face centered horizontally, both shoulders visible, bottom cut at upper chest, no hands in frame. Do not cut off hair or hat. Keep outfit neckline recognizable. Straight camera, no perspective tilt, no three-quarter face, no gaze to side, no smile showing teeth. One person in one standalone image. No text, logos, watermark, border, grid or collage.
